attributes.additional_details:
Beatrice Solomon's case cannot be ruled out as suicide.

She was a loving mother to a little child.

Where is her history of battling mental health? 

Who was last to see her alive?

Why didn't her family know about her situation?

How does one deprive oneself of oxygen?

Did her workplace have proof she was mentally unstable?
attributes.background: Beatrice Solomon's death was ruled as death my oxygen deprivation. Evidence shows she researched her death in her mobile. Her husband changed his Facebook status to "widowed" almost instantly. This death needs more investigation as her family deserves closure. The Nigerian community in UK deserve it
